notes.title: Celebrate the New Year: Special Sale and New Features Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/9f32cdc4e1d29d3d7192a0fb13b93a8c718d3f7b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/83e8ef728ceedfa5d666bfbff132e662a0cf124e.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear Players,[/b]  

The Lunar New Year is just around the corner! After a long review process, the trading cards for Nebel and the corresponding community rewards are finally live. To celebrate this occasion, we’re also putting Nebel and 5 Days Mischief Game on sale! Here are the details:  

1. Trading Cards for *Nebel Geisterjäger* Are Now Available!  
   This is our first attempt at trading cards. The artist and I worked hard to meet Steam’s requirements while balancing player preferences, revising the designs multiple times. We hope you enjoy them!  

2. Full Support for Traditional Chinese  
   Although this announcement is a bit late, we’re excited to share that all of our games now fully support Traditional Chinese. We hope you’ll give them a try!  

3. Steam Cloud Save Support  
   To help you continue your game progress anytime, anywhere, all of our games now support Steam Cloud Save. We hope you enjoy this new feature!  

Thank you for your continued support and love for our games. We wish you a joyful and rewarding Lunar New Year! Be sure to check out our store pages and don’t miss the upcoming sale!  

[b]Happy New Year![/b]  
From the Development Team

notes.title: "Dropped into the Modern World: Surviving the Red-Light District" Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841070][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716407/1262504c8003ca90f96002530a06e8f67d40ce1b.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841070

We sincerely apologize for the delay!
Kabukicho will finally be released at noon on the 16th of this month (Japan time)!
The translation work was originally completed by the end of July, but due to the summer sale, the release had to be postponed until now. We are truly sorry for the inconvenience.
This game is set in Kabukicho, incorporating a lot of real-life experiences while telling a slightly unconventional reverse-isekai naughty adventure story. We hope you enjoy it! If you could add it to your wishlist or support us, it would be greatly appreciated.

Meanwhile, BBQ has been developing an audio player using UE5 over the past few months.
This project is expected to be released on Steam within the next month. In addition to being an excellent audio player, it will also serve as a platform for uploading and selling various ASMR audio, including all past audio works by BBQ Daisuki.
Although we can’t reveal too much yet, if you're interested, you can experience the demo through the preview of the latest ASMR work by BBQ Daisuki on Dlsite (we apologize that due to Steam's policies, we cannot provide a direct link).

Lastly, if you are interested in our latest progress, you can check it out on our Cien page. You can find out how to access our Cien page on our Twitter (again, we apologize that due to Steam's policies, we cannot provide a direct link).

Happy summer vacation!
BBQ Daisuki

notes.title: "BBQ大好き" Welcomes the New Year: Trading Cards and Special Discount Announcement!
notes.notes:
To everyone who has continuously supported us at "BBQ大好き",

First and foremost, we would like to express our deepest gratitude for your ongoing support and affection towards our team. While it might be a standard feature for other games, our newly launched Steam games "Nebel Geisterjäger ~ The First Lamb" and "Devil's 5 Days Mischief Game" have finally obtained permission for Steam Trading Cards. As a token of our gratitude, we are planning to release these unique trading cards as soon as possible, hoping that you will enjoy them.

Furthermore, with the re-release of "Devil's 5 Days Mischief Game" on Steam and coinciding with New Year's Day, we are offering a 40% discount on the BBQ three-game bundle, including the newly added "Devil's 5 Days Mischief Game". Those who have previously purchased the discount bundle will also be able to enjoy this offer.

Thank you once again for your steadfast support...
Happy New Year, and may the new year be filled with laughter and new adventures.

BBQ大好き

notes.title: Important Update Notice for "DEVIL'S 5 DAYS MISCHIEF GAME"
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We extend our heartfelt thanks for your ongoing support and affection towards our game development team, "BBQ大好き". We are excited to announce that as of January 1, 2023, the APP for "DEVIL'S 5 DAYS MISCHIEF GAME" will be officially taken over by our team, "BBQ大好き". All future maintenance and development activities will be handled by our team.

We would like to express our gratitude to Seikei Production for their contributions to the game's maintenance and operations. Their work has provided important support for the game.

We look forward to your continued support in the future and hope you will keep an eye out for more works from both Seikei Production and "BBQ大好き".

Thank you all!

[b]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent replacement of certain content in the Steam version of "DEVIL'S 5 DAYS MISCHIEF GAME". This update may have unintentionally reverted the game content back to the Steam version for some players who had already installed the complete version. Please be assured that this update will not affect your saved games. To restore your game to the previous version, you can replace the game content by visiting the "BBQ大好き" homepage, accessible from the right side of the store page. We deeply regret any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding.[/b]


Team BBQ大好き
